ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AD \perp BC$, $BE \perp AC$, with the feet of the perpendiculars being points D and E, respectively, $AD$ and $BE$ intersect at point F, $BF=AC$, $\angle ABE=20^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle CAD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AD\perp BC$, $BE\perp AC$,\\
thus $\angle BDF = \angle ADC = 90^\circ$, $\angle BEC = \angle ADC = 90^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle DAC + \angle C = 90^\circ$, $\angle DBF + \angle C = 90^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle DBF = \angle DAC$,\\
in $\triangle DBF$ and $\triangle DAC$,\\
$\left\{\begin{array}{l} \angle BDF = \angle ADC \hfill \\ \angle DBF = \angle DAC \hfill \\ BF = AC \hfill \end{array}\right.$, \\
thus $\triangle DBF \cong \triangle DAC$ (AAS),\\
thus $AD = BD$,\\
given that $\angle ADB = 90^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle ABD = \angle DAB = 45^\circ$,\\
given that $\angle ABE = 20^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle CAD = \angle DBF = \angle ABD - \angle ABE = 45^\circ - 20^\circ = \boxed{25^\circ}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, A is above, B and C are below on the same straight line, D is on BC, and AD is a vertical line segment from A to the base BC; E is on AC, and BE connects from B to AC and intersects AD at F. In the figure, BE is located inside ∠ABD, and F is at the intersection point of AD and BE. Reasoning: From the given, AD⊥BC, so ∠BDF=90°, and ∠ADC=90°. Since BE⊥AC, and E is on AC, and B,D,C are collinear, it can be known that in right triangle BEC, ∠DBF and ∠C are complementary, that is, ∠DBF+∠C=90°. At the same time, in right triangle ADC, ∠DAC+∠C=90°. Therefore ∠DBF=∠DAC. Compare △DBF and △DAC: ∠BDF=∠ADC=90°, ∠DBF=∠DAC, and the problem gives BF=AC, so the two triangles are congruent. Therefore the corresponding sides BD=AD. Also because AD⊥BD, △ABD is a right triangle, and AD=BD, so △ABD is an isosceles right triangle, and ∠ABD=45°. In the figure, BE is inside ∠ABD, and ∠ABE=20°, so ∠DBF=∠ABD-∠ABE=45°-20°=25°. Also ∠CAD=∠DAC=∠DBF, so ∠CAD=25°.
